tool_args.rationale: The gradient probe distinguishes open and inhibited branches, but the fixed-horizon observations leave the proposed two-layer temporal mechanism underidentified. A trajectory batch can discriminate its dynamics before model confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All seven observations share the same horizon, initial state, and memory, so they cannot identify the temporal dynamics or dependence on those inputs.
Already acquired; it established gradient dependence but did not vary the temporal conditions.
It does not resolve the mechanism of interest.
